description: This file defines the ApiError class used for representing standardized error responses in a REST API, including fields for timestamp, status code, error message, and optional validation error details.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: A data class encapsulating details of an API error response, including timestamp, HTTP status, error message, location path, and validation field errors.

methods.name: ApiError(Instant timestamp, int status, String error, String message, String path)
methods.description: Constructor initializing all core error response fields.

methods.name: getTimestamp()
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the error occurred.

methods.name: setTimestamp(Instant timestamp)
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the error occurred.

methods.name: getPath()
methods.description: Returns the API request path where the error occurred.

methods.name: getFieldErrors()
methods.description: Returns the map of field validation errors.

methods.name: setFieldErrors(Map<String, String> fieldErrors)
methods.description: Sets the map of field validation errors.
